correctness.rationale: Exact limiting interval maxima, half-contraction by adjoining one vertex, sharp boundary inequalities, increasing/decreasing ramp equality, and uniform weighted-average error bound prove the claims for all n>=2 and a,b>0. value.rationale: The mass-concentration profile reveals a sharp structural failure of the uniform-mass 1/2 regularizing property, with asymmetry-dependent leading constant, linear positive-epsilon error and an unattained global n-1 bound. It fills a natural parameter-stability question for weighted discrete maximal operators without claiming a general arbitrary-weight classification.
